script: set -eu; scratch=.fabro/tmp/bdd; archive_root=.fabro/tmp/bdd-plan/scenarios; for directory in .fabro .fabro/tmp .fabro/tmp/bdd-plan $archive_root; do if test -L $directory; then echo 'Cannot prepare scenario: archive path component must not be a symbolic link.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if test -e $directory && ! test -d $directory; then echo 'Cannot prepare scenario: archive path component is not a directory.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! test -e $directory; then mkdir $directory; fi; done; if test -L $scratch; then echo 'Cannot prepare scenario: .fabro/tmp/bdd must not be a symbolic link.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if test -e $scratch && ! test -d $scratch; then echo 'Cannot prepare scenario: .fabro/tmp/bdd is not a directory.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if test -d $scratch && find $scratch -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then sequence=1; while test -e $archive_root/$sequence || test -L $archive_root/$sequence; do sequence=$((sequence + 1)); done; mv $scratch $archive_root/$sequence; fi; mkdir -p $scratch
